Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling through the intersection on a green signal when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a
second vehicle, operated by Driver 2, which entered from a cross street. Responding officers observed that the
damage to both vehicles was consistent with a broadside collision of this type and force. Driver 1 was seated behind
the wheel at the time of impact, and this was confirmed by the arriving officers, by independent witnesses at the
scene, and by Driver 2, who stated that the sequence of events occurred as Driver 1 described. A Passenger was
also present in the front seat and was not injured in the collision. Driver 1 reported pain and swelling to the left wrist
and was transported for evaluation, where the reported injury was described as a fracture consistent with the
mechanism of the crash. Photographs taken at the scene were reviewed and show no prior damage to the vehicle's
driver-side panels or frame. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No further
contributing factors were identified at the scene.
